workforce_control_plane.authority: task and workforce lifecycle interface only

orchestration.authority: bounded task decomposition and agent coordination only

model_runtimes.requirement: Each model/runtime adapter must be separately tested, version-pinned, cost-classified and permission-scoped.

architecture.trust_boundary: All platform and model inputs are untrusted until authenticated and authorized by external services.
flow: Owner or approved scheduler creates scoped task
Identity issuer attaches verified company-bound agent identity
Paperclip adapter submits task metadata to workforce control plane
Ruflo adapter decomposes only within parent task scope
Each child task is validated by deterministic policy service
Model runtime gateway selects an approved compatible runtime
Tool/data gateway rechecks authorization immediately before each operation
Cost meter blocks billable work above task and company caps
Audit sink records decisions, provenance, output digests and side-effect results
Revocation service can cancel tasks and invalidate grants at any time

adapter_requirements.identity_mapping: Map external immutable agent_id, company_id, role_id, runtime_id and session_id to platform metadata; never trust platform display names as authentication.
adapter_requirements.task_mapping: Preserve task_id, parent_task_id, company_id, issuer, assignee, scope, allowed tools, resource classes, expiry, cost cap, idempotency key and approval requirements without lossy conversion.
adapter_requirements.permission_translation: Fail closed when a platform cannot express a requested deny rule or scope restriction. Never silently broaden permissions to fit platform capability.
adapter_requirements.tool_invocation: All tools execute through a gateway that validates a fresh, single-use policy decision; direct model-to-tool bypass is prohibited.
adapter_requirements.memory_access: Memory is company- and agent-scoped; every retrieval is authorized by the data gateway; shared memory is disabled by default.
adapter_requirements.model_selection: Routing may optimize task suitability but cannot alter company, identity, permissions, budget, approval or data scope.
adapter_requirements.event_handling: Consume task accepted, started, completed, failed, timed out, cancelled and revoked events; authenticate event origin and enforce monotonic state transitions.
adapter_requirements.retry_handling: Retries are bounded and idempotency-aware; uncertain external outcomes go to reconciliation/quarantine rather than blind retry.
adapter_requirements.observability: Trace task, agent, runtime, model, tool, policy decision, source provenance, cost and audit correlation IDs; redact secrets.
adapter_requirements.versioning: Pin platform, adapter, model and policy versions; upgrades require compatibility and regression tests before promotion.

non_bypassable_invariants: No direct tool execution from model context.
No Paperclip or Ruflo setting can override external policy service decisions.
No model or agent can issue or sign its own identity or authorization token.
No task can expand parent scope, capability profile, cost cap or approval authority.
No cross-company memory, credentials, task payload or records by default.
No paid inference or compute when CAD 0 cost cap applies.
No external side effect without exact owner approval where required.
Policy, audit or revocation service failure blocks consequential operations.

compatibility_gate.accepted_only_if: All critical negative tests pass and there is evidence that the runtime cannot bypass the policy and tool gateways.
